title: Health Snapshot
description: Capture the box's memory and load-average snapshot into a health report file.
scenario: Morning standup needs today's health snapshot of the staging box: memory state and the load averages. Produce /home/intern/health-report.txt containing the full output of `free -m` (memory in megabytes) and `uptime` (load averages) — the two commands behind every 'how is the box doing?' conversation.
symptoms: Standup asks 'how is staging actually doing?' and nobody has numbers
The health report file does not exist yet
The team standard: free -m for memory, uptime for load average

hints.title: free -m
hints.content: Shows total/used/free memory in MEGABYTES (-m). The Mem: row is the one everyone quotes.

hints.title: uptime
hints.content: The three load averages (1/5/15-minute) appear after 'load average:' — the quick pulse of CPU pressure.

hints.title: Group redirection
hints.content: `{ free -m; uptime; } > file` runs both commands and sends their COMBINED output to one file.

acceptance_criteria.description: report contains the free -m Mem: row
report contains the uptime load average line
